dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Paris is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Paris has been observed to be fearful and is noted to be avoidant of handlers. She will begin to seek exit when they attempt to interact with her. Recently Paris has begun to snap at handlers when they interact with her. Such as when a handler attempted to remove their slip leash, Paris snapped at their hand. Her previous owner describes her as active and playful. Medically, Paris is currently healthy.

Paris arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner describes her as active and playful. While in care, Paris has been observed to be fearful and is noted to be avoidant of handlers and will begin to seek when they attempt to interact with her. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
